method.coverage: The pre-existing ledger documents an AI-assisted field-by-field review of all 500 IDs; this snapshot carries original and proposed-final fields for every row compared with the user's starting main SHA.
method.source_scope: Source checks are attached only to entries containing a lexical item, pronoun, or pronunciation convention addressed by that source. They support that component or general tone/pronoun distinction, not the complete naturalness of each full sentence.
method.confidence: MEDIUM means no specific issue was identified in the record-level AI review; it is not independent language certification. LOW / AMBIGUOUS is explicitly flagged below. No HIGH ratings are assigned because there is no independent fluent Thai–Myanmar sign-off.
method.limitations: No external source review has been recorded for every full sentence, Burmese translation, or Myanmar-script reading. All rows remain provisional until a fluent Thai–Myanmar reviewer checks them.

Provenance is listed by the official Medical Council-hosted PDF; selected exact health terms were checked in a searchable Scribd-hosted text reproduction of the same manual because the official PDF's later pages intermittently returned 403/503. Supports lexical/meaning comparisons for selected common expressions, allergy, fever, rash, and breathing difficulty only. The extracted text renders some Burmese in legacy encoding. It does not validate complete learner sentences, speaker-gender variants, Myanmar-script readings, food-allergy wording, medical advice, or the full corpus.

corpus_wide_checks.name: Full record review
corpus_wide_checks.scope: All 500 records received an AI-assisted field-by-field review; all 191 high-risk records also received a focused pass. This is not bilingual human certification.

corpus_wide_checks.name: Myanmar speaker pronouns
corpus_wide_checks.scope: Seven Myanmar meaning fields aligned to the Thai male/female first-person variants; NIU Burmese vocabulary source checks the pronoun distinction.

corpus_wide_checks.name: Thai pronunciation consistency
corpus_wide_checks.scope: Checked 43 rows containing ไม่, 189 with interrogative ไหม, and 151 with ได้. Corrected three convention mismatches for ไม่ and one omitted ได้ไหม reading.

corpus_wide_checks.name: Common lexical source checks
corpus_wide_checks.scope: Longdo/NECTEC Lexitron entries checked for selected recurring words; source checks attach to matching records and cover the word/component only.

corpus_wide_checks.name: High-risk terminology
corpus_wide_checks.scope: Ministry of Labour source checked for employment/overtime terminology; health sources checked for allergy wording limits. These references do not provide medical, legal, immigration, or employment advice.

corpus_wide_checks.name: Thai grammar/register source checks
corpus_wide_checks.scope: NIU SEASite Thai-language profile and Spoken Thai teaching material were mapped to matching records for pronouns, pro-drop, negation, questions, polite particles, and short/long conversational forms. These illustrate grammar/register patterns but do not validate every full phrase.

corpus_wide_checks.name: Focused allergy-language follow-up
corpus_wide_checks.scope: Source-checked the generic drug and food allergy openings, clarified the Burmese food-allergy wording, and added a note to state the exact food and symptoms. Both entries are MEDIUM because the wording is supported while the cards remain intentionally nonspecific; complete clinical histories and independent fluent Thai–Myanmar sentence review are outside these checks.
